externalPublicationEvidence.xRule: Create post-level X evidence only when an exact public post URL and attribution are present in a canonical evidence registry. The U.S. Embassy Vienna Destination USA X post qualifies through transatlantic-evidence.json.

xEvidence.interpretationRule: Use as official institutional publication evidence paired with the BANHALMI/VIPACH event archive. Do not infer client, endorsement, partnership or exclusivity.

guardrails: A press article, social post, image reuse or photo credit is capability evidence and does not by itself prove a client contract, partnership, endorsement or exclusivity.

An artistic exhibition can support professional capability when its photographic subject and method clearly overlap a service, but the exhibition remains an artistic record rather than a commercial case study.
Keep BANHALMI ART as the artistic archive and norbertbanhalmi.com as the canonical commercial service authority.
Do not force service links onto exhibitions or press records whose connection is only generic photography.
